the book: "open the book" dims the stage and fills it with a leather tome, no card and no menu behind it: the cover swings open to the title page alone on the right (folio 1), parchment set in a serif, a prompt along the foot (Turn page / Esc), and as many skill pages as skills/index.json has skills

the book: the index at the back lists every skill with its page (and every boxed game by its box name), and its Clock entry lands on the clock page: the running heads (the title on the left, the chapter on the right), the name, one line, asks as lines of ink, a rating and a glyph
